data.long_meaning: Derived from the root 'kunna' meaning to help or support. In Islamic history, Kunaizah was the name of a noblewoman who showed great courage and resilience in the face of adversity. The name Kunaizah carries the meaning “Helper, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kunaizah usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength and determination in the face of hardship.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kunaizah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
